map.像素不足时降低 DPI 或改用更小的输出规格: When pixels fall short, lower the DPI or switch to a smaller output size
map.DPI 越低打印尺寸越大但近看颗粒越明显，墙面大幅输出可放宽、手持照片建议 ≥3: The lower the DPI the larger the print size, but the grain is more visible up close; large wall prints can relax it, while handheld photos are best at 300 or more.
